rules: Six listed geographical origins; two +3 domains; one extra PC.
Nomad chooses heat or cold resistance.
One domain may be replaced by social origin or livelihood; livelihood cannot be a profile; no combat tests.
Custom origins are defined by the GM.
compatibility: Missing origin remains manual; no default or numeric skill bonus is fabricated. Human history +5 replaces this branch; stale origin cannot stack.
fixtureCorrections: Shield path without a shield changed to a neutral legal path.
No-profile fixture does not select the reserved Mage ancestry path.
Priest fixture retains mastered weapons instead of an unmastered dagger.
pdfIteration: New contextual Mage summary initially used an absent voieMage.rank property. It now calculates the highest acquired Mage rank; dedicated tests assert +4 at rank 2.
